goal: Prove RICK Intelligence as a distributed, durable, secure, multi-tenant, observable, recoverable, evidence-grounded and production-grade platform without promoting unobserved runtime behavior.

sources.license_notes: User-supplied acceptance prompt; used as a requirements snapshot.
Current repository audit and evidence boundary.

criteria.target: Canonical CI exposes FAST, UNIT, CONTRACT, SECURITY, RAG_EVAL, FRONTEND, SUPPLY_CHAIN and RELEASE; classification and return codes are derived and fail closed.
criteria.evidence_method: Inspect workflows and run make validate, workflow checks and triple-aaa-verify known-good/known-bad fixtures.

baseline.actual: Local control checks pass; current workflow and promotion closure require a fresh exact-candidate review.

criteria.conditions: Runtime-heavy lanes may be manual/nightly but cannot be replaced by mocks.
criteria.validity_notes: Known-bad blocked, stale and malformed evidence must be rejected.

criteria.target: Every mandatory gate has current commit_sha, tree_sha, artifact_hash, gate_id, status, timestamp, procedure, environment, reviewer and evidence_path; sealing prevents mutation and status bypass.
criteria.evidence_method: Run release-integrity against exact clean checkout and tamper fixtures for wrong commit/tree/hash, missing/blocked/stale/self-promoted gates.

baseline.actual: Typed v2 manifest and negative tests exist; current manifest is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and the full target is not satisfied.

criteria.conditions: The manifest cannot self-reference its own bytes.
criteria.validity_notes: A current-looking timestamp is insufficient without exact byte bindings.

criteria.target: A disposable owned stack starts Postgres, Redis, Qdrant, S3-compatible storage, API, Worker A/B, Web and OTel, waits for health/readiness, probes endpoints and tears down safely.
criteria.evidence_method: Run guarded make up/down with unique project scope, health/readiness observations and redacted diagnostics.

baseline.actual: Compose/static contract passes; Docker daemon access is denied, so the runtime target is not run.

criteria.conditions: No host-owned process may be treated as disposable lab evidence.
criteria.validity_notes: The lab must fail closed on missing configuration or readiness timeout.

criteria.target: Real PostgreSQL, two workers, object storage and Qdrant prove migrations, queue/lease/fencing, crash recovery, lineage and golden ingestion without duplicate or unsafe publication.
criteria.evidence_method: Execute real service gates and the RICK_GOLDEN_RUNTIME_PATH with fault matrix, raw artifacts, state checks, checksums and independent review.

baseline.actual: Local adapters and tests exist; no approved full runtime is available, so the runtime target is not run.

criteria.conditions: Fake DB, in-memory queue and static code cannot satisfy this criterion.
criteria.validity_notes: Every crash boundary must reconcile job, lease, attempt, outbox, audit and publication state.

criteria.target: Real Redis multi-replica coordination/rate limiting and real S3/Qdrant lifecycle pass auth, isolation, checksums, aliases, rebuild, restore and failure semantics.
criteria.evidence_method: Run API A/B and object/vector runtime gates against explicitly approved disposable endpoints.

baseline.actual: Static/local adapter evidence only; approved endpoints are unavailable, so the runtime target is not run.

criteria.conditions: Qdrant remains a projection and local filesystem is not production authority.
criteria.license_notes: No external production endpoint is used by local verification.
criteria.validity_notes: Alternating replicas must share the same bucket and projection recovery must preserve authority.

criteria.target: Tenant A/B isolation and evidence negatives reject content, IDs, metadata and timing-sensitive leakage, forged IDs, stale versions, wrong checksums, unknown chunks and injections.
criteria.evidence_method: Run local known-bad fixtures and approved live cross-tenant API/store/retrieval/evidence/decision negatives.

baseline.actual: Local ACL/adversarial/redaction coverage exists; live end-to-end isolation is not proven, so the full target is not run.

criteria.conditions: Retrieved content remains untrusted data and server-generated evidence IDs are required.
criteria.validity_notes: A UI-hidden resource or a unit-level allow test does not prove authorization.

criteria.target: Citation relevance, validity, support, faithfulness and unsupported-claim metrics feed conservative ANSWER/RETRIEVE_AGAIN/CLARIFY/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE decisions under bounded provider budgets.
criteria.evidence_method: Run approved corpus/provider contract, timeout/retry/cancel/429/500/tool/JSON and adversarial RAG matrix with metrics.

baseline.actual: Offline evaluator and provider seams exist; endpoint, corpus and authority are absent, so the runtime target is not run.

criteria.conditions: No paid or unbounded provider use; corpus license and thresholds must be explicit.
criteria.validity_notes: A high retrieval score cannot mask unsupported citations or decision-layer errors.

criteria.target: Real OTel propagation covers HTTP through decision, diagnostics redact nested/escaped secrets, bounded metrics exist and DEV/STAGING/PRODUCTION SLOs remain separated.
criteria.evidence_method: Observe collector/backend traces, metric samples, redaction negatives, alerts and environment-specific SLO packet.

baseline.actual: Local telemetry/redaction/static SLO evidence exists; distributed export and alerts are not run, so the full target is not run.

criteria.conditions: Tenant/user/content values cannot become unbounded metric dimensions.
criteria.license_notes: No secret values in logs or traces.
criteria.validity_notes: Source configuration alone cannot prove propagation or delivery.

criteria.target: Seed/backup/destroy/restore/rebuild/verify, chaos, short/extended soak and declared 1/10/50/100 performance loads pass with no silent corruption, duplicate publication or unbounded retry/resource drift.
criteria.evidence_method: Run isolated drills with RPO/RTO, p50/p95/p99, throughput, errors, CPU/RAM, resource and recovery artifacts.

baseline.actual: Runbooks and static helpers exist; no service-level drill is current.

criteria.conditions: Local fixture benchmarks are not production SLO evidence.
criteria.license_notes: Destructive actions only in isolated disposable copies.
criteria.validity_notes: Restoration must verify authority, lineage, audit, jobs, object data and rebuildable projections.

criteria.target: The real frontend/API path passes login, chat, upload, documents, sources, job status and degraded states at 375/768/1440 with keyboard/focus/axe/screen-reader/zoom/contrast/reduced-motion/touch evidence and fresh visual review.
criteria.evidence_method: Run browser route/state matrix, capture native screenshots, inspect console/network and obtain a blind read-only visual critic.

baseline.actual: Static build/lint/type checks and historical visual work exist; no current full packet is bound, so the full target is not run.

criteria.conditions: Source code and a resized screenshot cannot establish visual quality.
criteria.license_notes: Product identity and exact copy are preserved.
criteria.validity_notes: Missing viewport/state or interaction evidence remains blocked.

criteria.target: Dependency/secret/license/container audits, SBOM, artifact hashes/digests/signatures and non-root/read-only/capability/resource/health hardening are current for the exact artifact.
criteria.evidence_method: Run available scanners and inspect immutable outputs bound to the candidate image/artifact digests.

baseline.actual: Pinned workflows and partial audits exist; complete scan/signature packet is absent, so the full target is not run.

criteria.conditions: Scanner output is evidence to assess, not a universal security proof.
criteria.validity_notes: A dependency audit cannot replace runtime container and provenance checks.

criteria.target: Architecture, security, runtime, database, observability, recovery, RAG, frontend and operations reviews attempt rejection; zero Critical/High findings remain; sealed packet and final Go/No-Go bind the exact candidate.
criteria.evidence_method: Use fresh blind reviewers with mutation sentinels, recompute score/classification and inspect explicit authority record.

baseline.actual: Historical scoped reviews exist; no current full promotion packet or human decision.

criteria.conditions: Reviewers cannot be fabricated or replaced by builder self-review.
criteria.license_notes: Reviewer identity and independence are evidence fields.
criteria.validity_notes: Weighted score cannot override mandatory blockers or residual high risk.
